reason: Manifest stem said 'Level-7' and otherwise matches; rewritten cleanly.
work: sec a sec b = (tan a − tan b)/sin(π/6) ⇒ sum = 2[tan(θ+π/2) − tanθ] = −2(cotθ + tanθ) = 4 ⇒ tanθ = −1 ⇒ θ = 3π/4, 7π/4
